assessments.reasoning: The three verified publisher ranges supply the alternative grounds, the distribution trigger and the referenced notice itself. Section 10.4 applies to source meeting the definition by either route. This normative conclusion rests on the instrument.

challenge.method: Tested actual attachment by the initial Contributor with no earlier licensing history, earlier MPL-only availability with no prior attachment, and an accompanying full document with neither fact.
challenge.results: Each of the first two cases independently triggers the attachment requirement on the stated distribution. In particular, a distributor of historically incompatible source cannot omit the notice merely because it was absent before. The accompanying document alone establishes neither ground.

limitations: The duty turns on source-form distribution under this version. Establishing incompatibility in a particular case requires evidence of the initial Contributor’s attachment or of prior licensing.
reasoning: Section 10.4 requires attachment of the Exhibit B notice when the distributor chooses MPL 2.0 distribution of incompatible Source Code Form. Section 1.5 supplies two independent ways the material can already be incompatible.
